leadText:
Ikari (Japanese: イカリ Ikari) is a character of the day who appeared in Smashing with Sketch!.

His nickname is Ikari (Japanese: ドラゴンのイカリ Ikari the Dragon), because of the draconic vibe he gives off. He is a Pokémon Ping-Pong player and was known for winning the Pokémon Ping-Pong tournament to become Pokémon Ping-Pong champion of Alola year after year. During one such competition, he defeated Ilima in the finals and they formed a rivalry.

In the present day, he took part in another tournament. After he reached the finals, he went up against Ilima once more, but was finally defeated. After his defeat, Ikari and Ilima ended their animosity towards one another, as did their Pokémon.

==Pokémon==
 

==Pokémon competitions==
Ikari has competed in the following :
Pokémon Ping-Pong tournament - Winner, Pokémon Ping-Pong champion of Alola (one year before Smashing with Sketch!)
Pokémon Ping-Pong tournament - Runner-Up (Smashing with Sketch!)

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
Ikari's character and signature Poké-Ping Pong move is a reference to the character Ryūichi Kazama from the series .
Ikari's name literally translates to "anger", which is a reference to his animosity towards Ilima.
